title: Flow Field
blurb: Particles confined to one soft, organic region around a quiet central void, trailing hairlines that brighten only where they cross.

title: Contour Grid
blurb: The contour lines of one island, cropped as a single landform with its summit as the brightest point.

title: Moiré
blurb: Two concentric ring families crossing into moiré.

title: Orbitals
blurb: Concentric arcs turning at different rates around one centre.

title: Grain Field
blurb: Fine grain gathered into one soft drifting cloud with a long falloff — the quietest piece, and the home-page hero.
safeZone: left ~60%, clear of the hero copy

title: Wireframe Lattice
blurb: A rigid 3D grid rippling in perspective.

title: Longwave
blurb: Seven long ribbons sweeping the full width.

title: Relay
blurb: A canopy of branching hairlines grown from one root, a pulse climbing to the tips.

title: Infall
blurb: Matter spiralling inward to a bright core.

title: Mooring
blurb: One rope of twisted hairlines rising into a single loose loop; the crossing glows.

title: Funnel
blurb: A funnel seen side-on: stacked hairline ellipses narrowing to one bright tip, slowly twisting.

title: Rainfall
blurb: Sparse vertical streaks falling at their own speed, each with a brighter head.

title: Lacuna
blurb: Broken caustic arcs gather around an off-centre calm zone.

title: Parallax
blurb: A rose-to-amber fan parts around an unseen volume, with near strands slipping past finer distant lines.

title: Cipher Bloom
blurb: Irregular glyphs gather into a bright oblique core, then dissolve into warm chalk and shadow.

title: Driftwork
blurb: Violet-grey ellipse marks drift through two crossing currents, gathering and dissolving like woven air.

title: Pleat
blurb: Coral and ivory marks gather into two folded surfaces, divided by a clean cut of space.

title: Globe
blurb: A lat/long wire sphere spinning in true perspective, tilt and yaw draggable.

title: Dune
blurb: One wind-cut ridge built from film grain, its face caught by a low raking light and crossed by faint ripples.

title: Swell
blurb: A single ocean swell rising on a diagonal, drawn in halftone dots whose size carries the light on its face.
